description: Emprises de pans de toits favorables à une production d'électricité photovoltaïque (calcul 2021) is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche de données représente les emprises de pans de toits dont l'ensoleillement est supérieur à 1 000 kWh/m2/an. Il s'agit d'un calcul réalisé à partir d'une couche de données raster d'irradiance elle-même dérivée du Modèle Numérique de Surface 2021. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. Its keywords are facteur climatique, source d'énergie non polluante, source d'énergie renouvelable. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2023-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
